rfam.description: Turnip crinkle virus (TCV) repressor of minus strand synthesis H5
rfam.comment: This family represents the turnip crinkle virus (TCV) hairpin 5 (H5) which contains a large symmetrical internal loop (LSL). H5 can repress minus-strand synthesis when the 3' side of the LSL pairs with the 3'-terminal 4 bases of the RNA(GCCC-OH) [1,2].
